The '''Nara system''' was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It contained<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the resort known as [[Nara Parks]].<ref name="HanSolo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nara [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
